**Working for you and District 2**
==================================

Addressing our biggest challenges starts with supporting our children and their families with living wages and job opportunities, affordable housing, safe streets and reliable transportation, and healthy and nurturing activities.

who worked multiple jobs to make ends meet. Things didn’t come easy but with the community’s help, I learned the value of family and perseverance.



I worked my way through college and graduate school where I studied urban studies, public policy, and governance. Now I work for the City of Seattle as an outreach and policy advisor. I am a Protec17 Union member and I live with my wife and two daughters in Rainier Beach.

We all agree that our young people should have better opportunities than turning to the streets. We need more housing working families can afford. We need safer streets and more transportation options. Everyone deserves to feel safe and welcome. And we must protect our civil rights from federal threats.

> I’ve had the pleasure of knowing Adonis both personally and professionally for several years—and as a neighbor! His experience working for the City, his background in public policy, and the relationships he’s built throughout the area make him uniquely qualified to represent District 2. But more than that, he’s an active member of our community. I regularly see him at local coffee shops, neighborhood events, and public safety meetings. Now, it’s exciting to see him take the next step and run for city council. I wish him the best of luck, and my neighbors and I will be cheering him on every step of the way!
>
>
>
>
> Erin Goodman
> *Rainier Beach Resident*

> I had the pleasure of being a part of the District 2 city council appointment process with Adonis and he impressed me. He showed me that he's a smart, thoughtful, and poised individual who really cares about South Seattle. I'm looking forward to seeing more of this up-and-coming leader during the District 2 city council race.
>
>
>
>
> Mark Solomon
> *City of Seattle Councilmember District 2*

> Adonis has a vision for District 2 that has earned my respect. His ideas and solutions will take us from the present to a better future. He understands a Seattle safe for children is a City secure for all. Residents, families and businesses would benefit from his common sense leadership.
>
>
>
>
> Dawn Mason
> *Former State Representative*

> I have known Adonis since the late 80’s and as far back as I can remember he's always been a genuine and positive person. He's heavily involved with the Seattle skate community volunteering his time to help kids and adults learn to skate. It's really exciting to see him take this next step on his journey and run for the District 2 city council seat. He will no doubt bring the same character and energy to the race and City Hall once he's elected in November. I'm hyped to see this!
>
>
>
>
> Marshall Stack Reid
> *Manager, All Together Skatepark Seattle*

> Adonis is the kind of person who shows up—for his friends, his family, and his community. Whether he's helping a new skater drop in for the first time or organizing to make Seattle a better place for all of us, he brings patience, passion, and real care to everything he does. As a dad, a skater, and a longtime community leader, he understands the needs of District 2 firsthand. I have no doubt he’ll bring that same dedication and energy to City Hall. Hyped to see him in this race and even more excited to see him win!

> We need Adonis' commitment to jobs, affordability, and sustainability on City Council. He will be a strong voice for the smart planning-- and community engagement-- needed to make Seattle a place where we can all live, work, and thrive.
>
>
>
>
> Ryan Calkins

> Adonis will bring important perspectives to Council-from a lifetime living and working in South Seattle. He’s a good listener with a record of bringing diverse voices to the table to shape positive solutions. He deserves our vote.
>
> Joy Hollingsworth
> *City of Seattle Councilmember District 3*

> We need more leaders on the City Council who understand their neighborhoods, fight for our values, and care about the safety and affordability of our city. Adonis will be that leader for District 2. We share not only a passion for public service, but first jobs delivering newspapers in our neighborhoods! I’m excited to endorse his candidacy, and look forward to working with him on Council.
>
>
>
>
> Dan Strauss
> *City of Seattle Councilmember District District 6*

> I've known Adonis his entire life and watched him grow up to become a loving father and respected community leader. I'm really excited to see what's next for Adonis-- and urge you to elect him to the City Council.
